annotations.title: Mortgage, LHA, cost-index and council-tax-band reference rates

description:
Published reference rates: `mortgage` (Bank of England averages, UK-wide, no
    place), `lha` (Local Housing Allowance, needs place {postcode} and beds 1-4;
    RATES ARE WEEKLY: multiply by 52/12 before comparing with a monthly rent),
    `cost_index` (construction cost index series; needs basis, optional sector,
    freq, from_period, to_period such as 2024Q1) and `council_tax_band` (needs
    place {uprn}; the band is declared by the VOA, not predicted, and a band
    is not a bill).

    Do NOT use it for a mortgage quote, a build cost or a value: an index is a
    movement, not a cost. A missing rate answers covered=false with the reason, never an
    error inside a 200.
    Free.

    UK only (council tax: England and Wales). Limits: at most 30 rows, 8 KB.
    A call with covered=false or an upstream failure is not charged.

PlaceArg.description: Exactly one of uprn, postcode, area, geometry. Free text is refused: call resolve_place first.
PlaceArg.title: PlaceArg

code.description: Lowercase postcode district ('e5') or an ONS/GSS code ('E09000012').
code.title: Code
